name: Church of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception
description: A stunning baroque-style church with a striking white facade and a majestic bell tower, iconic to Panaji's skyline.

name: Miramar Beach
description: A serene sandy beach where the Mandovi River meets the Arabian Sea, perfect for sunset views and leisurely strolls.

name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter
description: A charming heritage neighborhood with colorful Portuguese-style houses, narrow lanes, and vibrant street art.

name: Goa State Museum
description: A museum showcasing Goa’s rich history, art, and culture through fascinating artifacts and exhibits.

name: Mahalaxmi Temple
description: A revered Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Mahalaxmi, known for its peaceful ambiance and intricate architecture.

name: Panaji Market
description: Bustling local market offering fresh produce, spices, Goan handicrafts, and vibrant street food stalls.

name: Dona Paula Viewpoint
description: A scenic spot offering panoramic views of the Arabian Sea and the confluence of the Mandovi and Zuari rivers.

name: Kala Academy
description: A cultural complex hosting art exhibitions, music concerts, and theater performances, promoting Goan arts.

name: Mandovi River Cruise
description: Enjoy a relaxing evening cruise on the Mandovi River with live music and stunning views of Panaji’s waterfront.

name: Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary
description: A mangrove habitat on Chorao Island, home to diverse bird species, ideal for birdwatching and nature walks.

name: Adil Shah's Palace
description: Ruins of a 16th-century palace built by the Sultan of Bijapur, offering a glimpse into Goa’s pre-Portuguese history.

name: Panaji Jetty
description: A lively waterfront jetty where locals and tourists gather to enjoy river views and boat rides.

name: Municipal Garden
description: A well-maintained garden with lush greenery, fountains, and walking paths, perfect for a peaceful break.

name: Goa Science Centre
description: An interactive science museum featuring exhibits on space, technology, and natural sciences, great for families.

name: Caculo Mall
description: A modern shopping mall offering a variety of retail stores, eateries, and entertainment options in Panaji.

name: Goa State Central Library
description: A historic library with an extensive collection of books and manuscripts, reflecting Goa’s literary heritage.

name: Mandovi Riverfront Promenade
description: A scenic walkway along the Mandovi River lined with cafes, street vendors, and lively evening ambiance.

name: Panaji Heritage Walk
description: A guided walking tour through Panaji’s historic sites, hidden alleys, and colonial architecture, revealing local stories.

name: St. Sebastian Chapel
description: A quaint chapel dedicated to St. Sebastian, known for its peaceful environment and beautiful stained glass windows.

name: Goa State Art Gallery
description: An art gallery exhibiting contemporary and traditional Goan art, hosting regular exhibitions and workshops.
